section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants of an experiment conducted at a German university. The sample consisted of 87 undergraduates, with 80% being women, and an average age of 23.55 years (SD = 3.89, range 19-37). Participants received either study points or 20 DM for their involvement, and only those without prior experience with the specific software package were allowed to participate.
